reconfigure.title: {model}
reconfigure.description: How this model should speak a reply that is still being written.

data_description.stream_mode:
Automatic lets the app decide for each reply, from what it has measured of this model on its own host: spoken as it is written when the model keeps ahead of its audio, and planned when it does not. A voice it has not heard yet borrows the dearest figures the model has, and a model it has never run at all is planned from its own first request — so nothing waits for a measurement that has not been taken.

The other three take the decision away, each giving up something different. Plan the whole reply waits for the words, then cuts them so playback never catches the renderer — it never stalls, but on a model slower than its own audio the wait before the first word grows with the reply, and can run to minutes. Speak as it renders is the same words cut the other way, cut for the soonest first word and with nothing held back; on a model that cannot keep ahead it stalls between sentences, audibly, which is the trade it offers. Nothing held back is not the same as no wait: the first request still has to render, and on a model slower than its own audio that alone can be half a minute. Wait for the whole reply renders everything in one request before anything plays: the longest wait, and the only way to get a reply the model never had to cut.

Every model starts on Wait for the whole reply. Automatic reaches the first word sooner than it, and Speak as it renders sooner than either.

abort.model_comes_from_the_server: Models are not added here. Download one in the Cortex TTS app and it appears on this page by itself.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Saved. It applies to the next reply.

options.auto: Automatic — let the app decide for each reply
options.planned: Plan the whole reply — never stalls, may wait a while first
options.unheld: Speak as it renders — first word as soon as one exists, stalls if it cannot keep up
options.buffered: Wait for the whole reply — never stalls, longest wait
